name: s17-strtypes
title: The three string types
spec: Three boxes side by side. str: Unicode text, immutable (green). bytes: raw 8-bit values, immutable. bytearray: raw 8-bit values, mutable (orange). Under them two arrows between str and bytes: encode (str to bytes) and decode (bytes to str).
cap: Python 3 has text (str), immutable bytes and mutable bytearray, and encoding converts between text and bytes.

name: s17-manage
title: Attribute management techniques compared
spec: A four-row table with columns technique and what it intercepts. property: one named attribute. descriptor: one attribute, reusable across classes (green). __getattr__: only attributes that are not found. __getattribute__: every attribute fetch (orange, slowest and riskiest).
cap: Properties, descriptors, __getattr__ and __getattribute__ differ in which attribute accesses they intercept.

name: s17-decoargs
title: A decorator with arguments
spec: Three nested rounded boxes from outside in: outer layer deco(arg) takes the decorator arguments ; middle layer decorator(func) takes the function ; inner layer wrapper(*args) runs on each call (green). Top code chip: @deco(3) above def f. Arrow caption: deco(3) returns the real decorator.
cap: A decorator with arguments has one more level: deco(arg) returns the decorator, which returns the wrapper.
